title: REC-C5 — Agent API convergence via alias sunset+delete
summary: Shrink the MCP tool surface to the canonical v2 agent API (12 v2 + 29 not-yet-converged = 41 tools, was 63). C5.1 sunset markers, C5.2 shrink sandbox test callers, C5.3 delete 22 alias handlers (split into C5.3.1 client migration and C5.3.2 server delete).

findings_introduced.summary: C5.2 deferred sandbox client wrapper migration; C5.3 must split into C5.3.1 (client) + C5.3.2 (server delete).
m0_03_ebpf_probe_lifecycle_impl fails both before and after C5.2 migration (per a035a3c9 commit message). Pre-existing flake owned by REC-C3.5 Tren B, NOT introduced by REC-C5.
Sandbox test_get_execution_summary_busyloop fails when analytics_tools runs immediately after e2e_connectivity under system load (passes in isolation and 3/3 in back-to-back runs).

propose.summary: Path A-lite. Three slices: C5.1 sunset markers (done, f9fa14b1), C5.2 shrink sandbox test callers (done, a035a3c9), C5.3 delete 22 alias handlers from server.rs and drop legacy shims (uncommitted working tree).

specify.summary: Will land after C5.3 design. Required: acceptance criteria per alias; map every test consumer to its v2 caller; pin ALL_TOOL_NAMES length (12 v2 + 29 not-yet-converged = 41, was 63); toolset_sync_check invariant.

design.summary: C5.3 design surfaces an unstated coupling: chronos-sandbox/src/client/tools.rs has 22 v1 wrapper methods that alias C5.3 to delete. C5.2 explicitly deferred them ('belong to a dedicated slice'). C5.3 must split: C5.3.1 (client migration) then C5.3.2 (server.rs delete commit).

evidence_observed: Baseline cargo check -p chronos-mcp --all-targets at HEAD a035a3c9: Finished dev profile in 35.76s (clean, no errors).
Baseline branch contains 22 alias handlers (chronos-mcp/src/server.rs) and 22 corresponding sandbox client wrappers (chronos-sandbox/src/client/tools.rs).

Working tree (uncommitted) removes the 22 alias handlers; cargo check with the diff fails on chronos-mcp/tests/sessions_tools.rs:6637 calling server.forensic_memory_audit() and on the 14 sandbox test files using client.<v1_alias>() — 23 call sites across 14 files.
toolset_sync_check test at server.rs:7911 still references ALL_TOOL_NAMES length; must be revisited once C5.3.1 re-derives the v2-only length.

_legacy_carry_forward_findings_removed_i: The C5.3-MIGRATION-COUPLING finding moved to findings_introduced (P0, owned by C5.3.1). FIND-C5.2-1/2 moved to findings_introduced (P3 pre-existing flakes).
next_cycle_recommendation: After REC-C5 closes, the next active gate is REC-C6 — Close unfinished M1–M4 reconstruction contracts. The contracts.toml will tell which sub-cycles still own partial contracts. After REC-C6, REC-C7 is the strict close gate that unlocks official M6 OpenTelemetry correlation + export.
